xrefdescription.para: MBM-01: OURS_WINS resolves a conflicting field in favour of ours.

detaileddescription.para: Base has field "status"="pending". Ours changes it to "approved". Theirs changes it to "rejected". OURS_WINS must produce "approved".

xrefdescription.para: MBM-02: THEIRS_WINS resolves a conflicting field in favour of theirs.
MBM-03: FAIL strategy returns ERR_DOC_MERGE_CONFLICT when fields diverge.
MBM-04: Clean merge (no conflict) succeeds under all three strategies.

detaileddescription.para: Ours adds field "a"; theirs adds field "b"; base has neither. No shared field is modified, so all strategies must produce a clean merge.

xrefdescription.para: MBM-05: Multi-field document — partial conflict, OURS_WINS strategy.

detaileddescription.para: Base has three fields. Ours modifies field "c". Theirs modifies fields "b" and "c" (creating a conflict on "c"). OURS_WINS must preserve ours' "c" value and merge theirs' "b" change cleanly.

xrefdescription.para: MBM-06: Chained merge — three sequential branch merges converge cleanly.

detaileddescription.para: Models: A branched into B and C; C branched into D. Merge(A, B, C) → BC; Merge(A, BC, D) → final. All branches modify distinct fields, so no conflicts arise.

xrefdescription.para: MBM-07: Merge returns ERR_DOC_DIFF_NOT_FOUND when base document is absent.
MBM-08: Symmetric conflict — swapping ours/theirs changes OURS_WINS outcome.

detaileddescription.para: Verifies that the merge result is not commutative when OURS_WINS is applied and that swapping the branch positions flips the resolved value.

xrefdescription.para: SSV-01: Registering the same version twice returns ERR_DOC_SCHEMA_VERSION_EXISTS.
SSV-02: Validating against an unknown version returns ERR_DOC_SCHEMA_VERSION_NOT_FOUND.
SSV-03: Version ordering — registeredVersions() returns versions in ascending order regardless of registration order.
SSV-04: Document with missing required field fails validation.

detaileddescription.para: Registers a schema with a required field "id". Validates a document body that omits the required field and expects a non-empty violations list.

xrefdescription.para: SSV-05: Registering a new schema version after v1 is valid (forward-only).

detaileddescription.para: Verifies that v2 can be registered independently after v1 and that both versions coexist in the registry without interfering.

xrefdescription.para: SSV-06: Type mismatch on a required field produces a violation.

detaileddescription.para: Schema expects field "count" to be of type NUMBER. Document provides a STRING — must result in a type violation.

xrefdescription.para: ODE-01: ERR_DOC_EXCHANGE_BOUNDARY_VIOLATED classifies as EXCHANGE_ERROR.
ODE-02: ERR_DOC_DIFF_NOT_FOUND classifies as EXCHANGE_ERROR.

detaileddescription.para: diff() is the primary XDOMEA-adjacent operation that produces this error.

xrefdescription.para: ODE-03: ERR_DOC_ROUND_TRIP_PERSIST_FAIL classifies as ROUND_TRIP_ERROR.
ODE-04: ERR_DOC_SNAPSHOT_COLLISION classifies as ROUND_TRIP_ERROR.
ODE-05: DocumentDiagnosticSink correctly counts EXCHANGE_ERROR events.

detaileddescription.para: Records three exchange errors and verifies that count() returns 3 and totalCount() returns 3.

xrefdescription.para: ODE-06: DocumentDiagnosticSink correctly counts ROUND_TRIP_ERROR events.
ODE-07: Mixed error-class recording produces correct per-class counts.

detaileddescription.para: Records events spanning EXCHANGE_ERROR, ROUND_TRIP_ERROR, and MERGE_CONFLICT. Verifies that each class counter is independent and the total is the sum.

xrefdescription.para: ODE-08: documentErrorDescription returns a non-empty string for all EXCHANGE_ERROR and ROUND_TRIP_ERROR codes.

detaileddescription.para: Guards against silent gaps in the description map for the critical exchange and round-trip failure paths.

briefdescription.para: Document module multi-branch merge, schema sealing/transition, and operator diagnostics focused tests.

detaileddescription.para: Covers three test categories addressing the Q4 2026 Planned Features backlog in src/document/ROADMAP.md:

listitem.para: MultiBranchMerge (MBM-01 … MBM-08): exhaustive multi-branch three-way merge permutations across all MergeStrategy values and conflict scenarios.
SchemaSealVersion (SSV-01 … SSV-06): schema sealing enforcement and version-transition ordering edge cases.

OperatorDiagnostics (ODE-01 … ODE-08): DocumentDiagnosticSink counting, classifyDocumentError, formatDocumentError, and documentErrorDescription coverage for EXCHANGE_ERROR and ROUND_TRIP_ERROR paths.

detaileddescription.para: All tests use deterministic fixtures; where document IDs are generated programmatically, the canonical seed kCDCanonicalSeed = 42 is used.

simplesect.para: Target: Q4 2026 hardening sprint — Planned Features closure
